mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) can potentiate sympathomimetic effects and increase risk of hypertensive crisis and arrhythmias, while digoxin has narrow therapeutic index and increased cardiac sensitivity; combined use elevates arrhythmia risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor cardiac rhythm closely with ECG, maintain strict dietary restrictions (tyramine avoidance), and monitor digoxin levels carefully as toxicity risk is elevated.
